spec.scene: A warm wooden floor patch with a small woven cream rug in the center. A plush dusty-blue armchair sits angled comfortably, draped with a soft gray knit throw blanket. To the right, a round wooden end table holds an ochre ceramic mug, gently steaming under the glow of a small brass task lamp. At the back edge, a fragment of dark wall holds a framed geometric art print, filling the space with soft amber light.
spec.title: A Quiet Evening
